title: console-tooling-standup-log-march-week-2026
content:
Console & Tooling — weekly standup log (UI, rollouts, analytics) — week of 2026-03-08 to 2026-03-12

Owners: Maya Chen (owner), Diego Alvarez (frontend lead), Priya Nair (rollouts), Liam O'Connell (analytics)
Attendees: Maya, Diego, Priya, Liam, Ana, Karl, Shruti (partial)

Summary: Focus this week on finalizing the canary rollout gating for feature flags in the new Rollouts page, finishing the pending dashboard instrumentation for per-route latency breakdown, and shipping the UI tweak to the model-selection modal. We surfaced two small regressions in rollout toggles under heavy batch load — investigation in-progress.

Monday 2026-03-08
- Quick sync: confirmed rollout gating criteria (success = 99.5% requests under 300ms across canary, no >3% error spike for 12h). Agreed to add a temporary conservative fallback policy for early hours. (Action: Priya to add fallback policy config to CT-3412 by 2026-03-11)
- Diego demoed new model-selection modal — accessibility fixes pending (focus trap & keyboard nav). Ticket created: CT-3428.
- Analytics: Liam identified missing span tags in the route-level tracing for fallback flows; small mapping bug in ingestion pipeline.

Tuesday 2026-03-09
- Deep dive into rollback behavior when KV cache is warm: observed scenario where canary returns newer quantized variant incompatible with cache, causing tokenization mismatch and increased latency. Root cause traced to kernel selection edge-case. (Blocker)
  - Action: Engineering (serving-runtime) notified — cross-team follow-up scheduled Wed 10:30. (Linked: github PR and Slack thread)
- UI: Diego applied ARIA attributes to modal, PR 874 opened for review. QA checklist added in PR description.
- Analytics: Added histogram buckets for 50/100/200/500/1000ms in per-route dashboard; bump retention preview to 14d for rollout experiments. (Action: Liam to push updated dashboard JSON by end of week)

Wednesday 2026-03-10
- Cross-team with serving-runtime: discussed kernel-selection defender for quantized variants. Short-term mitigations: pin canary to model variant family that shares KV cache format; longer-term: add runtime compatibility flag. (Action: Priya to update rollout docs and create canary whitelist CT-3435)
- Rollouts page: added 'force fallback' button for emergency rollback in console. UX review notes: move confirmation to modal, require enter-key confirmation for prod rollbacks. (Action: Diego to iterate; aim for staging deploy Thu)
- Observability: Discovered a missing tag in ingestion config that prevented grouping by deployment-tier in the analytics view (hosted vs dedicated). (Action: Liam -> config change CT-3440)

Thursday 2026-03-11
- Standup: staging deploy of modal and updated rollouts page went out to staging at 09:20 — smoke tests green except for intermittent 502s when toggling many flags quickly. Investigation points to debounce missing on toggle UI and backend race.
  - Action: Diego to add frontend debounce (50ms) and better optimistic UI handling; backend SRE to add a short-term concurrency limiter.
- QA: Ana ran accessibility pass and reported two remaining keyboard issues and color-contrast warnings in the new analytics widgets. (Action: Diego to address; small CSS tweak and label updates)
- Metrics: Early telemetry from staging canaries shows latency distribution skew on sequences >1024 tokens when quantized variant is used. Flagging as high priority for rollout gating.

Friday 2026-03-12
- Retrospective for week: good cross-team communication; need clearer pre-canary checklist to include KV/quantization compatibility and analytics tagging verification.
- Action items consolidated and owners assigned below.
- Decision: postpone rolling new quantized variant to hosted until compatibility defender merged and a dry-run canary shows stable latency for 48h. Priya to notify customers on the waitlist by Monday.

Open Blockers
- Kernel selection compatibility with warm KV cache causing tokenization mismatch (blocking canary). Status: serving-runtime triage, expected ETA for mitigation patch 2026-03-17.
- Intermittent 502s from rapid toggle operations on rollouts endpoint. Status: backend SRE investigating; frontend debounce patch in review.

Action Items (owner — due)
- Priya Nair — add fallback policy config to CT-3412 (2026-03-11) [incomplete]
- Priya Nair — create canary whitelist + update docs CT-3435 (2026-03-12) [done]
- Diego Alvarez — PR 874: accessibility fixes & debounce on toggles (2026-03-13) [in review]
- Liam O'Connell — push updated per-route dashboard JSON & retention preview (CT-3440) (2026-03-13)
- Ana Ruiz — run full QA regression on Rollouts page on staging (2026-03-13)
- Maya Chen — customer comms draft for delayed quartile rollout (2026-03-15)

Notes & Observations
- Need a short 'pre-canary' checklist: include model-variant compatibility, KV cache format, analytics tags, per-route histogram buckets, and smoke-run schedule. Priya will draft and place in confluence under 'console-rollout-plan'.
- Consider adding a lightweight runtime compatibility probe that runs a few warm token loops before allowing variant into canary. Long-term idea but could prevent repeat incidents.
- Team health: people are overloaded with simultaneous rollback engineering and analytics work; call with product to re-prioritize items next Tuesday.

Related links (quick)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/874
- Jira: CT-3412 (rollout gating), CT-3428 (modal a11y), CT-3435 (canary whitelist), CT-3440 (analytics tagging)
- Confluence: confluence:redwood/console-rollout-plan

Appendix: quick smoke checklist (draft)
- Verify model variant compat with KV cache (unit test + short warm runs)
- Verify analytics tags present and ingestion non-erroring for sample traffic
- Smoke generate 100 short requests and 20 long requests; ensure P95 under threshold
- Confirm rollback trigger and emergency fallback works end-to-end

If anything is missing or you want a deeper dump from logs, ping the #console-rollouts channel or drop a note on the CT tickets.

-- Maya
